ns2:section.sectionText: Registration is restricted to Human Nutrition and Dietetics seniors and FSHN and DNS graduate students only until after senior registration. Remaining seats will be made available to Human Nutrition and Dietetics juniors at the end of senior registration. All other interested students should e-mail Dr. Margarita Teran (teranmd@illinois.edu) or Dr. Kelly Tappenden (tappende@illinois.edu) for permission to register for the class.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign or Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition or Nutritional Sciences department.
